s: Which of the following pairs about the AP Employment of Local Candidates in Industries/Factories Act is correctly matched?
x: The Act, passed in July 2019, reserves 75% of private jobs in industries and factories for local candidates.

s: Under VB-G RAM G, which combination is correct?
o: 150 days of work, no seasonal pause, and 50:50 funding
125 days of work, a peak-season pause of up to 90 days, and 90:10 funding
125 days of work, a peak-season pause of up to 60 days, and 60:40 Centre-State funding
100 days of work, a peak-season pause of up to 30 days, and 75:25 funding
x: VB-G RAM G guarantees 125 days of work, permits a pause of up to 60 days during peak farm seasons, and is funded in a 60:40 Centre-State ratio.

s: VB-G RAM G was launched nationally at which place in Andhra Pradesh?
x: The national launch of VB-G RAM G took place at Mukkavaripalli in Tirupati district.

s: The AP Employment of Local Candidates in Industries/Factories Act was widely criticised nationally mainly because it was considered a:
x: The law was widely criticised on the ground that reserving private-sector jobs for local candidates could deter investors.

s: Under VB-G RAM G, for how many days can work be paused in the peak agricultural season?
x: VB-G RAM G gives 125 days of work, with a pause of up to 60 days in peak season and 60:40 Centre:State funding.

s: In which year did Andhra Pradesh enact the Employment of Local Candidates in Industries/Factories Act?
x: The Act was passed in July 2019 and reserves 75% of private jobs for local candidates.

s: In 2025-26, Andhra Pradesh ranked how high nationally in employment generation under MGNREGS, with 1,635.10 lakh person-days?
x: Andhra Pradesh ranked third nationally in MGNREGS employment generation, recording 1,635.10 lakh person-days against a labour budget of 1,800 lakh.

s: As per PLFS 2023-24, what was the unemployment rate (all ages) of Andhra Pradesh?
x: AP's overall unemployment was 4.1%, while youth unemployment was about 17.5%.

s:
Consider the following statements about unemployment in Andhra Pradesh (PLFS 2023-24):
1. The overall unemployment rate was 4.1%.
2. Youth unemployment, about 17.5%, was below the national level.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Overall unemployment was 4.1%; youth unemployment (about 17.5%) was far above the national level.

s: What is the MGNREGS wage rate in Andhra Pradesh for 2025-26?
x: The wage rate was raised from ₹300 to ₹307 a day for 2025-26.

s: What was the share of women in MGNREGS employment in Andhra Pradesh in 2025-26?
x: Women's share in MGNREGS work in AP in 2025-26 was 60.54%. 75% is the share of private jobs reserved for locals under the 2019 Act; the other figures are not the women's share.

s: Under PM-SETU, how many Government ITIs in Andhra Pradesh are to be upgraded as hubs and spokes?
x: All 83 Government ITIs are to be upgraded as 16 hubs and 67 spokes.

s: On which date is World Youth Skills Day observed?
x: World Youth Skills Day is 15 July, declared by the UNGA in 2014.

s: PMKVY 4.0 mainly offers which type of courses?
o: Industry 4.0 courses such as coding, AI, robotics and drones
x: PMKVY 4.0 focuses on Industry 4.0 courses like coding, AI, robotics, mechatronics, IoT, 3D printing and drones.

s: Which body is the nodal agency in AP for placement-linked training through Skill Hubs and Skill Spokes?
x: APSSDC is the nodal agency for placement-linked training through Skill Hubs, Skill Spokes, colleges and Sector Skill Councils.

s: What placement threshold applies to all State skill schemes in Andhra Pradesh?
x: A 70% placement threshold applies to all State skill schemes.

s: The proposed merger of skill departments in Andhra Pradesh is meant to create which single body?
o: Commissionerate of Skill, Employment and Training
Department of Rural Industries and Employment
x: The skill departments are proposed to be merged into one Commissionerate of Skill, Employment and Training under the One District–One Skill plan.

s: In which year was the Andhra Pradesh State Skill Development Corporation (APSSDC) set up?
x: APSSDC was set up in 2014 as a not-for-profit company on the lines of NSDC.

s: What is the motto of the single Commissionerate of Skill, Employment and Training being formed in Andhra Pradesh (April 2026)?
x: All skill departments are merging into one Commissionerate with the motto 'One District – One Skill'.

s: The Andhra Pradesh State Skill Development Corporation was set up in 2014 as a not-for-profit company on the lines of which national body?
x: APSSDC was set up in 2014 as a not-for-profit company on the lines of the National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC).

s: With which company did APSSDC set up Centres of Excellence in engineering colleges of Andhra Pradesh, such as at JNTU Anantapur?
x: APSSDC partnered with Siemens to set up Siemens Centres of Excellence in colleges such as JNTU Anantapur for industry skills.

s: The Naipunyam AI portal is intended to handle which combination of functions?
o: Wage fixation, recruitment examinations and pensions
Skill census, loan disbursement and migration control
x: The Naipunyam AI portal handles skilling, certification and job matching, with a goal of reaching 20 lakh people by 2029.

s: Skill Census 2024 in Andhra Pradesh maps which of the following for 100% of the youth?
x: Skill Census 2024 is a household survey to map the skills, qualifications and jobs of 100% of youth.

s:
Consider the following statements about Skill International in Andhra Pradesh:
1. It provides German (A1-B2) language training for overseas placement, mainly for nurses.
2. It signed a Letter of Intent with a German body, FVCC, for overseas placement.

x: Statement 1 is correct; the Letter of Intent (6 May 2026) was with Japan's FVCC, not a German body.

s: Which of the following is the target under the Super Six programme of Andhra Pradesh regarding employment?
x: The Super Six target is to create 20 lakh jobs in five years.

s: Which Super Six scheme provides an announced ₹3,000 a month to unemployed youth?
x: Nirudyoga Bruthi, a Super Six promise, provides ₹3,000 a month to unemployed youth; Yuva Nestham was the 2014-19 allowance scheme.

s: Yuva Nestham was an unemployment allowance scheme for educated youth under which government?
o: The 2004-09 Congress government in Andhra Pradesh
The 2019-24 YSRCP government in Andhra Pradesh
The 2014-19 TDP government in Andhra Pradesh
x: Yuva Nestham provided unemployment allowance for educated youth under the 2014-19 TDP government in Andhra Pradesh.

s: What target has been set for the Naipunyam AI portal of Andhra Pradesh by 2029?
x: Naipunyam, the AI portal for skilling, certification and job matching, has a goal of 20 lakh by 2029.

s: Which body implements DDU-GKY in Andhra Pradesh?
x: DDU-GKY is implemented by SEEDAP, DAY-NRLM by SERP and DAY-NULM by MEPMA.

s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
x: Rural DAY-NRLM is run by SERP, urban DAY-NULM by MEPMA and DDU-GKY by SEEDAP.

s: Through which body does Andhra Pradesh rank first in India in SHG-bank linkage?
x: SERP, which runs the rural livelihood mission DAY-NRLM, is 1st in India in SHG-bank linkage.

s: Up to what amount and at what rate of interest does Streenidhi give loans to SHG members in Andhra Pradesh?
x: Streenidhi gives SHG members loans up to ₹1 lakh at 11% interest.

s: How many Lakhpati Didis are there in Andhra Pradesh?
x: Andhra Pradesh has 20.31 lakh Lakhpati Didis; 2.74 lakh is the number of MEPMA SHGs.

s: About how many SHGs come under MEPMA, which runs DAY-NULM in Andhra Pradesh?
x: MEPMA runs DAY-NULM (urban) and has about 2.74 lakh SHGs.

s: The upper age limit for government jobs in Andhra Pradesh has been raised to which age, and up to which year does this provision apply?
x: The upper age limit for government jobs has been raised to 44 years till 2027.

s: Which State has been reported as the top State on the iGOT Karmayogi platform, with more than one crore enrolments?
x: Andhra Pradesh is the top State on iGOT Karmayogi, with over one crore enrolments.

s: Village and ward secretariats in Andhra Pradesh have been redesignated as which department?
o: Palle Pragathi and Ward Secretariat department
Grama Seva and Ward Development department
Swarna Andhra Village and Urban Services department
Swarna Gramam and Swarna Ward department
x: Village and ward secretariats are now known as the Swarna Gramam and Swarna Ward department.

s: Mega DSC-2025 in Andhra Pradesh recruited how many teachers?
x: Mega DSC-2025 recruited 15,941 teachers.

s: Under which Act does OMCAP work as the nodal agency for overseas recruitment in Andhra Pradesh?
x: OMCAP (Overseas Manpower Company AP Ltd) is the nodal agency for overseas recruitment under the Emigration Act, 1983.

s: Over 90% of abuse complaints from Gulf migrant workers of Andhra Pradesh come from those not recruited through which agency?
x: Housemaids must be recruited via OMCAP, and over 90% of abuse complaints come from workers not recruited through it.

s: What is the full form of OMCAP, the overseas recruitment agency of Andhra Pradesh?
o: Overseas Manpower Corporation of AP Board
x: OMCAP is the Overseas Manpower Company AP Ltd, working under the Emigration Act, 1983.

s: From which area of Andhra Pradesh is Gulf migration among women especially heavy?
x: Gulf migration is heavy among women from coastal Konaseema; housemaids must go via OMCAP.

s: Village and ward secretariats in Andhra Pradesh now function under which department?
x: Secretariats are now under the Swarna Gramam and Swarna Ward department.

s: What was the total allocation for BC welfare in Andhra Pradesh's 2026-27 Budget?
x: BC welfare got Rs 51,021 crore (of which the BC department Rs 23,650.88 crore), SC welfare Rs 20,644 crore and minorities Rs 6,090 crore.

s: With which of the following are Jagananna Vidya Deevena and Vasathi Deevena respectively associated?
o: Hostel costs and full fee reimbursement
Full fee reimbursement and hostel costs
x: Vidya Deevena provides full fee reimbursement, while Vasathi Deevena supports hostel costs.

s: What was the allocation for SC welfare in Andhra Pradesh's 2026-27 Budget?
x: SC welfare got ₹20,644 crore; ₹51,021 crore is total BC welfare and ₹6,090 crore is for minorities.

s: Jagananna Vidya Deevena's 100% fee reimbursement beyond Intermediate does NOT cover which of the following groups as listed?
x: Vidya Deevena covers SC, ST, BC, Minority, Kapu, EBC and Differently Abled students, not all general-category students.

s: To whom are honoraria of ₹5,000–10,000 (March 2026) paid under minority welfare in Andhra Pradesh?
x: Under minority welfare, Imams and Mouzams get ₹5,000–10,000 honoraria (March 2026).

s: What is the name of the Andhra Pradesh portal for scholarships and fee reimbursement, linked with Aadhaar?
x: Jnanabhumi is the Aadhaar-linked portal for scholarships and fee reimbursement.

s: What did the NTR Videsi Vidya Adarana scheme of Andhra Pradesh provide?
o: Overseas-study aid for SC, ST, BC and minority students
Loans to youth for foreign jobs
x: NTR Videsi Vidya Adarana gave overseas-study aid to SC, ST, BC and minority students; it was replaced by Jagananna Videshi Vidya Deevena.

s: The Dudekula community, listed in Andhra Pradesh's BC list, belongs to which religious group?
x: The Dudekula are a Muslim community in AP's BC list; they got special cover in the 2021-22 budget.

s:

2. The MPI value rose from 0.025 to 0.053.

x: The MPI fell from 0.053 to 0.025 (SES 2025-26); statement 2 reverses the direction.

s: Under Navaratnalu (2019–24), through whom, besides DBT, was welfare delivered?
x: Navaratnalu's nine pillars were delivered by DBT and village/ward volunteers, who also coordinated ration delivery.

s: What does Talliki Vandanam give under the Super Six package?
x: Talliki Vandanam gives ₹15,000 per school child; ₹20,000 is Annadata Sukhibhava and ₹1,500/month is Aadabidda Nidhi.

s: Which of the following pairs relating to the Super Six programme is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: Aadabidda Nidhi – ₹1,500 per month to women
Annadata Sukhibhava – ₹20,000 a year to farmers
Talliki Vandanam – ₹3,000 per month to the unemployed
x: Talliki Vandanam gives ₹15,000 per school child; ₹3,000/month is the unemployment allowance.

s: Which of the following was NOT one of the Navaratnalu?
x: Vahana Mitra (aid to auto/taxi drivers) was not among the nine Navaratnalu pillars.

s: Under which scheme did Andhra Pradesh give LPG connections to poor women before declaring itself a smoke-free State?
x: Under Deepam (2014-19) poor women got LPG connections, and AP was declared smoke-free on 8 June 2017.

s: What does the NTR Sujala scheme provide to villages?
o: RO drinking water at ₹2 per 20 litres
x: NTR Sujala supplies RO-purified drinking water at ₹2 per 20 litres.

s: Pasupu Kumkuma gave a grant of how much per DWCRA woman?
x: Pasupu Kumkuma (TDP, 2019) gave Rs 10,000 per DWCRA woman; YSR Aasara reimbursed SHG loans in instalments.

s: Under what name was Velugu merged with DWCRA?
x: Velugu (2000) was merged with DWCRA as Indira Kranthi Patham, run by SERP.

s: What does Stree Nidhi mainly provide to SHG members?
o: Full fee reimbursement for higher education
Timely and affordable credit, including loans up to ₹1 lakh at 11% interest
x: Stree Nidhi provides timely and affordable credit to SHG members, with loans up to ₹1 lakh at 11% interest.

s: Which institution assists the AP Rural Inclusive Growth Project, implemented by SERP?
x: The project is World Bank-assisted, implemented by SERP and has five components.

s: To whom did YSR Cheyutha of Andhra Pradesh give yearly financial aid?
o: all DWCRA women regardless of caste
x: YSR Cheyutha, a Navaratnalu scheme, gave yearly aid to SC/ST/BC/minority women.

s: The AP Rural Inclusive Growth Project (2015) covers how many most backward mandals?
x: The World Bank-aided APRIGP, run by SERP, covers the 150 most backward mandals.

s:
Consider the following statements about women's SHGs in Andhra Pradesh:
1. SERP mobilises about 84.47 lakh rural women.
2. Andhra Pradesh ranks first in India in SHG-bank linkage.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Both are correct: SERP mobilises 84.47 lakh rural women and AP is first in SHG-bank linkage.

s: Up to what amount and at what interest does Stree Nidhi in Andhra Pradesh lend to SHG members?
x: Stree Nidhi gives timely, affordable credit to SHG members up to ₹1 lakh at 11%.

s: What is the full form of DWCRA?
o: Development of Women and Children in Rural Areas
Development of Weaker Classes in Rural Areas
Department of Women and Child Rural Affairs
Development of Women and Children's Resources Association
x: DWCRA stands for Development of Women and Children in Rural Areas, started in 1982-83.

s: DWCRA (1982-83) was started as a sub-scheme of which programme?
x: DWCRA was a sub-scheme of the Integrated Rural Development Programme (IRDP).

s: Which scheme of Andhra Pradesh repaid SHG loans outstanding on 11 April 2019 in four instalments?
x: YSR Aasara repaid SHG loans outstanding on 11 April 2019 in four instalments.

s: What does the Integrated Rural Energy Programme provide?
o: Basic home energy for cooking, heating and lighting, with a renewable focus
Loans to SHGs for solar businesses
x: The Integrated Rural Energy Programme gives basic home energy (cooking, heating, lighting) with a renewable focus; it is not a women's income programme.

s: How much rice do AAY households receive under the public distribution system in Andhra Pradesh?
x: AAY beneficiaries get 35 kg per card, while PHH beneficiaries get 5 kg per person.

s: Under Mana Biyyam (2013), up to what ceiling did BPL families get fine rice at ₹1 per kg?
x: Mana Biyyam provided fine rice at ₹1 per kg to BPL families, with a maximum of 20 kg per family.

s: Through which method does the e-PDS system in Andhra Pradesh distribute food grains to BPL families?
o: Biometric authentication and real-time stock tracking
Paper coupons issued by Gram Panchayats
Cash transfers in place of grain
x: e-PDS distributes food grains to BPL families using biometric authentication and real-time stock tracking (a PYQ point). It does not use paper coupons, does not replace grain with cash, and works through fair price shops, not Anganwadis.

s: Which of the following pairs relating to subsidised commodities in Andhra Pradesh is NOT correctly matched?
o: Ragi and jowar — ₹20 per kg up to 3 kg
x: Ragi and jowar up to 3 kg are provided free, not at ₹20 per kg. The other three pairs are correctly matched.

s: As per SES 2025-26, how many Fair Price Shops operate in Andhra Pradesh?
x: Andhra Pradesh has 29,796 Fair Price Shops (SES 2025-26); 9,260 is the number of door-delivery vehicles.

s: At what rate do Priority Household (PHH) beneficiaries receive rice under the PDS in Andhra Pradesh?
x: PHH get 5 kg per person; 35 kg per card is the AAY entitlement and 20 kg per family was the Mana Biyyam cap.

s: When was the door delivery of ration through Mobile Dispensing Unit (MDU) vehicles in Andhra Pradesh discontinued?
x: The 2021 door delivery scheme used 9,260 MDU vehicles and was discontinued on 1 May 2025.

s: How are ragi and jowar supplied under the PDS in Andhra Pradesh?
x: Ragi and jowar are free up to 3 kg; ₹20/kg is the price of wheat atta, not millets.

s: Which district of Andhra Pradesh had the most ration shops (February 2017)?
x: Anantapuram had the largest number of ration shops in AP (Feb 2017).

s: What was the annual income ceiling for a white ration card in urban areas of Andhra Pradesh in 2017?
x: In 2017 the white ration card ceiling was ₹75,000 a year in urban areas and ₹60,000 in rural areas.

s: How many Mobile Dispensing Unit (MDU) vehicles were used for door delivery of ration in Andhra Pradesh from 2021?
x: Door delivery (2021) used 9,260 MDU vehicles costing ₹539 crore; it was stopped on 1 May 2025.

s: The AP Disha Bill, 2019 proposed which of the following timelines and penalty?
o: 14-day investigation, 7-day trial and life imprisonment only
x: The AP Disha Bill, 2019 proposed investigation within seven days, trial within fourteen days and the death penalty. It did not receive assent.

s: Mission Shakti in AP runs One Stop Centres in all districts and operates which helpline?
x: Mission Shakti runs One Stop Centres in all districts and operates the 181 helpline.

s:
Consider the following statements about the Stree Shakti scheme of Andhra Pradesh:
1. From 15 August 2025, it provides free bus travel to women and transgender persons.
2. Under it, the women's share of bus passengers rose from 40% to 65%.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Both are correct: Stree Shakti gives free bus travel to women and transgender persons from 15 August 2025, and women's share of passengers rose from 40% to 65%.

s: When did the State Cabinet withdraw the AP Disha Bill, 2019, which never received assent?
x: The Cabinet withdrew the Disha Bill in August 2026 on the Centre's advice after the BNS and BNSS came into force.

s: To brides from which communities does YSR Shaadi Tohfa give marriage aid in Andhra Pradesh?
x: Shaadi Tohfa is for minority brides; Kalyanamasthu covers SC, ST, BC, disabled and construction-worker brides.

s: What is the marriage aid for a BC bride under YSR Kalyanamasthu?
x: Kalyanamasthu gives ₹1 lakh to SC/ST brides and ₹50,000 to BC brides.

s: To whom does Divyang Shakti (March 2026) in Andhra Pradesh extend free bus travel?
x: Divyang Shakti extends Stree Shakti's free travel to persons with disabilities; transgender persons are already covered by Stree Shakti.

s: Through which body is ₹50,000 given to poor Muslim brides under the Dulhan scheme?
x: Dulhan gives ₹50,000 to poor Muslim brides through the AP State Minorities Finance Corporation.

s: Under Chandranna Pelli Kanuka (2014-19), how much was given for SC inter-caste marriages?
x: Chandranna Pelli Kanuka gave ₹75,000 for SC inter-caste marriages.

s: What is the Disha app of Andhra Pradesh?
o: An SOS app for women in distress, linked to Disha police stations
x: The Disha app is AP's SOS app for women in distress and is linked to Disha police stations.

s: Under YSR Kalyanamasthu and YSR Shaadi Tohfa, what minimum education must the bride and groom have passed?
x: Both the bride and groom must have passed SSC; the ages must be 18 and 21.

s: Under PMAY convergence (PMAY-U and PMAY-G) in Andhra Pradesh, what was the housing target by 2026?
x: The PMAY convergence target was 7.60 lakh houses by 2026. 2.61 lakh is the number of APTIDCO houses to be completed with the HUDCO loan; 5 lakh PMAY households are to get star-rated appliances; 61,084 houses were approved under PMAY-U 2.0.

s: Which of the following pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: YSR Jagananna Housing – launched in April 2006
x: YSR Jagananna Housing was launched on 3 June 2021; April 2006 is the launch of INDIRAMMA.

s: When was the INDIRAMMA housing programme of Andhra Pradesh launched?
x: INDIRAMMA (Integrated Novel Development in Rural Areas and Model Municipal Areas) began in April 2006.

s: Which body launched YSR Jagananna Housing, building houses in Jagananna colonies, on 3 June 2021?
x: YSR Jagananna Housing was launched on 3 June 2021 by the AP State Housing Corporation Ltd (APSHCL); HUDCO lends to APTIDCO.

s: Which of the following pairs (housing scheme – launch/period) is correctly matched?
x: NTR Housing ran under the TDP government in 2014–19; INDIRAMMA began in April 2006 and YSR Jagananna Housing on 3 June 2021.

s: What is the full form of INDIRAMMA, the housing programme launched in Andhra Pradesh in April 2006?
o: Integrated Novel Development in Rural Areas and Model Municipal Areas
Indira Rural Housing and Model Municipal Areas
Integrated New Development in Rural and Model Mandal Areas
Indira Development of Rural Areas and Model Mega Areas
x: INDIRAMMA stands for Integrated Novel Development in Rural Areas and Model Municipal Areas; it began in April 2006.

s: What was YSR Pension Kanuka in Andhra Pradesh renamed as in July 2024?
x: YSR Pension Kanuka was renamed NTR Bharosa pensions in July 2024.

s: What is the monthly pension for persons with disabilities under NTR Bharosa pensions?
x: Persons with disabilities get ₹6,000; ₹4,000 is the base pension, ₹10,000 for severe health conditions and ₹15,000 for the fully disabled.

s:
Consider the following statements about NTR Bharosa pensions:
1. Elderly persons, widows and transgender persons get ₹4,000 a month.
2. Fully disabled persons get ₹10,000 a month.
3. About 65.31 lakh beneficiaries across 28 categories were covered at launch.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Statements 1 and 3 are correct; fully disabled persons get ₹15,000, while ₹10,000 is for severe health conditions.

s: Who presented the first Budget of residuary Andhra Pradesh after bifurcation (2014)?
x: Yanamala Ramakrishnudu presented the first Budget of residuary Andhra Pradesh in 2014.

s: Who presented Andhra Pradesh's Budget 2026-27 on 14 February 2026?
x: Finance Minister Payyavula Keshav presented the 2025-26 and 2026-27 (14 February 2026) Budgets; Atchannaidu presents the Agriculture Budget.

s: What was the size of Andhra Pradesh's separate Agriculture Budget for 2026-27?
x: The 2026-27 Agriculture Budget was ₹53,752 crore, presented by K. Atchannaidu; ₹48,341 crore was the 2025-26 figure.

s: How much was allotted in Andhra Pradesh's 2014-15 Agriculture Budget for the farm loan waiver (Rythu Runa Mafi)?
x: The 2014-15 Agriculture Budget set aside ₹5,000 crore for Rythu Runa Mafi.

s: Under which Article of the Constitution did Andhra Pradesh present a vote on account in February 2019?
x: Article 206 provides for a vote on account; AP used it in the election year 2019.

x: The irrigation allocation in 2016-17 rose by about 57.6% over 2015-16 BE.

YSR Rythu Bharosa — Rs. 15,000; Amma Vodi — Rs. 12,500

s: How much central relief did Andhra Pradesh get for Cyclone Titli?
x: Cyclone Titli relief was ₹1,200 crore; ₹1,150 crore was the Agri Gold allocation of 2019-20.

s: In the Andhra Pradesh Budget 2019-20, ₹1,150 crore was allotted to compensate which group?
x: The 2019-20 Budget gave ₹1,150 crore for about 11.50 lakh Agri Gold victims.

s: By what percentage did the health allocation rise in the Andhra Pradesh Budget 2021-22?
x: Health got ₹13,830.44 crore in 2021-22, 21.1% more than before.

s: How much did the Andhra Pradesh Budget 2022-23 allot for Smart Cities?
x: The 2022-23 Budget gave ₹1,000 crore for Smart Cities.

s: Which of the following pairs relating to Andhra Pradesh's public debt is correctly matched?
o: Central loans – about 75% of public debt
Small savings (NSSF) – largest component of public debt
Market borrowings – about 75% of public debt
Market borrowings – about 8% of public debt
x: Market borrowings (₹4,83,093 crore in 2025-26 RE) form about 75% of the debt and are its largest component; central loans are about 8%.

s: What General and Central Government debt ceilings for 31 March 2025 did the FRBM framework, as amended in 2018, set?
x: The amended FRBM framework set a General Government debt ceiling of 60% of GDP and a Central Government ceiling of 40% by 31 March 2025.

s: Which one of the following correctly represents the outstanding public debt of Andhra Pradesh in 2022-23 and its ratio to GSDP?
x: In 2022-23, outstanding debt was ₹4,29,526 crore and debt was 32.60% of GSDP.

s: What was the public debt of residuary Andhra Pradesh as a percentage of GSDP in 2013-14?
x: Debt was 19.4% of GSDP in 2013-14 (PYQ key). 32.60% is 2022-23 actual; 34.14% is 2024-25 BE; 36.04% is 2025-26 RE, showing how much the ratio has risen.

The total liabilities of Andhra Pradesh, including public sector undertakings, were reported at approximately what amount as of 12 June 2024?
x: Total liabilities including public sector undertakings were reported at ₹9,74,556 crore as of 12 June 2024.

s: Under the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2014, on whom do loans re-lent for projects confined to only one successor State devolve?
o: The State in which the project is located
The State having the larger population
Both successor States in the population ratio
x: Loans re-lent for projects confined to one successor State devolve on that State under Section 54.

s:
Consider the following statements about Section 54 of the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2014:
1. Public Debt liabilities of the undivided State were apportioned on the basis of area.
2. Public Debt and Public Account liabilities were apportioned by population ratio.
3. Loans re-lent for a project confined to one successor State devolve on that State.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Section 54 apportions Public Debt and Public Account liabilities by population ratio, not area; loans re-lent for a project in one State pass to that State.

s: The N.K. Singh Committee (2017) recommended a general government debt ceiling of 60% of GDP. How was it split between the Centre and the States?
x: The committee set general government debt at 60% of GDP: Centre 40% and States 20%. AP's ~36% debt-GSDP is well above the 20% State benchmark. The other splits are wrong.

s: AP's debt-GSDP ratio of about 36% is well above the N.K. Singh benchmark for States. What is that benchmark?
x: The N.K. Singh benchmark for States is 20% of GSDP (Centre 40%), so AP's ~36% is well above it.

s: Among the following States, which had the highest debt-GSDP ratio in 2023-24?
x: Punjab 42.9%, West Bengal 38.3%, Rajasthan 37.9% and AP 34.6% (2023-24).

s: What fiscal deficit limit for States did the 16th Finance Commission recommend?
x: FC-16 set States' fiscal deficit at 3% of GSDP; 3.5% is for the Union.

s: In the 2024-25 RE, central loans formed about what share of Andhra Pradesh's public debt?
x: Central loans are about 8%; market loans 75%, small savings 1% and others 11%.

s: What is Andhra Pradesh's outstanding debt in the 2026-27 Budget Estimates?
x: The 2026-27 BE debt is ₹7,11,094 crore (~36% of GSDP); ₹9,74,556 crore is total liabilities including PSUs.

s: Since Andhra Pradesh continues to run a primary deficit, its borrowing is used to meet:
x: With a primary deficit, borrowing also finances current spending, not just past interest.

s: What does the 'golden rule' of public borrowing say borrowing should generally be used for?
x: The golden rule states that borrowing should be undertaken only for creating capital assets, rather than for routine revenue expenditure.

s: How are interest payments treated in the Andhra Pradesh Budget?
o: A voted item of developmental expenditure
A discretionary grant to local bodies
x: Interest payments are a charged item and are not subject to voting. They are also committed, non-developmental expenditure.

s: In what are investments of the Consolidated Sinking Fund made?
x: States contribute to the CSF to amortise liabilities, and it is invested in Government of India securities.

s: Guarantees given by the Andhra Pradesh government crystallise as liabilities only when they are:
x: Guarantees are contingent liabilities that crystallise if invoked; they are not part of outstanding debt before that.

s: Which of the following is NOT a recommendation of the Sixteenth Finance Commission?
o: Off-budget borrowings to remain outside the budget
Union fiscal deficit capped at 3.5% of GDP
States' fiscal deficit capped at 3% of GSDP
x: The 16th FC recommended bringing off-budget borrowings on budget and discontinuing them.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Andhra Pradesh's debt and guarantees?
o: Guarantees are included in outstanding debt
Small-savings deposits go to the National Small Savings Fund
Market borrowing was Rs 4,83,093 crore in 2025-26 RE
Guarantees were Rs 1,77,328 crore, or 10% of GSDP, in the 2026-27 Budget
x: Guarantees are contingent liabilities that lie outside outstanding debt.

s: Which of the following is a key indicator of the debt sustainability of a State?
x: Debt-GSDP and interest payments to revenue receipts are the key debt-sustainability indicators.

s: Who administers the Guarantee Redemption Fund maintained by States?
o: the Comptroller and Auditor General of India
x: The Guarantee Redemption Fund is an RBI-administered fund built by States to meet guarantees that are invoked.

s: According to the CAG (2024), what was Andhra Pradesh's off-budget debt in March 2023?
x: The CAG put off-budget debt at ₹1.28 lakh crore (9.7% of GSDP) in March 2023. ₹1,40,470 crore was the outstanding figure on 31 March 2024; ₹1.77 lakh crore (10%) is outstanding guarantees in Budget 2026-27; ₹3.11 lakh crore is sanctioned guarantee exposure.

s: Which one of the following correctly matches the year with Andhra Pradesh's interest payments?
x: Interest payments in 2017-18 RE were Rs. 14,783 crore. The other amounts belong to different years: Rs. 25,492 crore in 2022-23, Rs. 29,481 crore in 2023-24, Rs. 32,967 crore in 2024-25 and Rs. 37,233 crore in 2025-26 RE.

s: The principal concern about off-budget borrowings and State guarantees is that they:
x: Off-budget borrowings and guarantees obscure the true consolidated debt and may pressure sovereign ratings.

s: The use of off-budget routes by successive Andhra Pradesh governments was intended, among other things, to:
o: Avoid or get around FRBM borrowing caps
Replace all market borrowings with grants
x: Successive governments used off-budget routes to get around the borrowing caps imposed under the FRBM framework.

s: In Budget 2026–27, at what amount were Andhra Pradesh's outstanding guarantees shown?
x: Budget 2026–27 showed outstanding guarantees of ₹1,77,328 crore, equivalent to 10% of GSDP. The earlier figure was ₹1,54,797 crore, or 11% of GSDP, in 2023–24.

s: What does off-budget borrowing by Andhra Pradesh refer to?
o: Loans raised by State PSUs or corporations, serviced from the State budget but excluded from reported debt
Grants received from the Finance Commission
Direct State borrowing included in reported public debt
Loans from foreign governments not guaranteed by the State
x: Off-budget borrowings are raised by State entities but serviced from the State budget and kept outside reported debt.

s: Which corporation escrowed liquor revenue to borrow from banks for Andhra Pradesh?
x: The AP State Development Corporation (APSDC) escrowed liquor revenue; the High Court questioned tax revenue going to it instead of the Consolidated Fund.

s: Against what did the Centre adjust the off-budget borrowings of States for FY21–22?
x: Off-budget borrowings of FY21–22 were adjusted against the NBC of FY23; future ones count in the NBC.

s: What were Andhra Pradesh's off-budget borrowings outstanding on 31 March 2024?
x: Off-budget borrowings were ₹1,40,470 crore on 31 March 2024; ₹1.28 lakh crore was the March 2023 CAG figure.

s: What is the Consolidated Sinking Fund maintained by States used for?
x: The RBI-run CSF amortises liabilities; the Guarantee Redemption Fund meets invoked guarantees.

s:
Consider the following statements about APSDC:
1. It escrowed liquor revenue to borrow from banks.
2. The AP High Court questioned tax revenue going to APSDC instead of the Consolidated Fund of the State.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: APSDC escrowed liquor revenue to borrow from banks, and the AP High Court questioned tax revenue going to APSDC instead of the Consolidated Fund.

s: By November 2025, Andhra Pradesh had collected approximately what proportion of its annual revenue-receipts estimate?
x: Collections by November 2025 were ₹1.05 lakh crore, representing 48% of the annual estimate.

s: At what amount are the revenue receipts of Andhra Pradesh estimated in the 2026–27 Budget Estimates?
x: Andhra Pradesh’s revenue receipts for 2026–27 are estimated at ₹2,34,190 crore, representing an increase of 19%.

s: In the 2026–27 Budget Estimates, what are the shares of Andhra Pradesh's own resources and central transfers in revenue receipts, respectively?
x: Own resources are estimated at ₹1,37,320 crore, or 59%, while central transfers are ₹96,820 crore, or 41%.

s: In the 2024-25 RE, what is the order (highest to lowest share) of the components of Andhra Pradesh's revenue receipts?
o: Own Tax, Central Transfers, Own Non-Tax
Central Transfers, Own Tax, Own Non-Tax
Own Tax, Own Non-Tax, Central Transfers
Own Non-Tax, Own Tax, Central Transfers
x: Own Tax ranked first, then Central Transfers, with Own Non-Tax the smallest.

s: In the 2024-25 RE, own non-tax revenue formed about what share of Andhra Pradesh's revenue receipts?
x: Own non-tax revenue (Rs 7,018 crore) was only about 4%, while own tax was about half and central transfers about 45-47%.

s: In 2016-17, grants-in-aid from the Centre formed about what share of Andhra Pradesh's total revenue receipts?
x: Grants-in-aid were about 23.6% of AP's revenue receipts in 2016-17. 15% was the grants share in 2024-25 BE, and 41% is the share of all central transfers in 2026-27 BE.

s: Which of the following is a component of Tax Revenue?
x: Corporation tax is tax revenue. Interest, dividends and fees are non-tax revenue.

s: By November 2025, Andhra Pradesh's non-tax revenue collection stood at:
o: About one-third of the Budget Estimate
Below one-fifth of the Budget Estimate
Over one-half of the Budget Estimate
About one-fourth of the Budget Estimate
x: By November 2025, non-tax revenue collection was below one-fifth of the Budget Estimate.

s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
x: Corporation tax is tax revenue; interest receipts are non-tax revenue, market borrowings a capital receipt and pensions revenue expenditure.

s: What were Andhra Pradesh's revenue receipts in the 2024-25 Revised Estimates?
x: 2024-25 RE receipts were ₹1,91,142 crore against a BE of ₹2,01,174 crore.

s: According to the CAG, own tax revenue formed about what share of AP's revenue receipts in 2015-16?
x: The CAG put own tax revenue at about 45% of revenue receipts in 2015-16.

s: In the 2023-24 Revised Estimates, which was the largest component of Andhra Pradesh's own tax revenue?
x: GST constituted 36% of Andhra Pradesh’s own tax revenue in the 2023-24 Revised Estimates, the largest listed component.

s: In the 2024-25 Revised Estimates, which was the largest component of Andhra Pradesh's own tax revenue?
x: SGST led at 38%, followed by State excise (22%), sales tax (~19%), stamps and registration (~10%) and motor vehicles tax (~5%).

s: Which of the following tax heads recorded the largest shortfall from the Budget Estimate in Andhra Pradesh during 2024–25, as indicated by the percentage decline?
x: The shortfall was 35% for stamps and registration, compared with 29% for VAT and 22% for excise.

s: After GST, on which items does sales tax in Andhra Pradesh mainly continue?
x: Sales tax continues mainly on petroleum products and liquor, which remain outside GST; SGST was about 40 per cent in 2025-26 RE.

s: Andhra Pradesh's own tax revenue, estimated at Rs 1,25,846 crore, was about what share of GSDP?
x: Own tax revenue was Rs 1,25,846 crore, about 6.4% of GSDP, up 28%.

s: AP's own tax revenue is about 5.5–6.4% of GSDP. What is the average for States?
x: The States' average own tax is about 7% of GSDP. AP's own tax is only about 5.5–6.4% of GSDP, a relatively low own-revenue ratio.

s: What position does excise revenue, mainly from liquor, hold among Andhra Pradesh's own-tax sources?
x: Excise, principally liquor revenue, is AP's second-largest own-tax source.

s: Which was Andhra Pradesh's fastest-growing revenue head in the 2024-25 Budget, rising by 60%?
x: Excise was the fastest-growing head in the 2024-25 Budget with 60% growth; it formed about 22% of own-tax revenue in the RE.

s: As of December 2025, which State had the costliest petrol in India?
x: AP petrol cost ₹109.74 (VAT ₹29.06), above Telangana ₹107.46, Karnataka ₹102.92 and Tamil Nadu ₹100.80.

s: Since November 2021, at what rates does Andhra Pradesh levy VAT on petrol and diesel respectively?
x: AP's fuel VAT is 31% on petrol and 22.25% on diesel (November 2021).

s: Which is the smallest major head of Andhra Pradesh's own tax revenue?
x: Motor vehicle tax (about 5%, ₹4,320 crore in 2022-23) is the smallest major head.

s: Under AP's liquor policy of October 2024, at what price is a 180 ml bottle capped?
x: The October 2024 policy returned retail to private shops and capped 180 ml at ₹99.

s:
Consider the following statements about Andhra Pradesh's liquor policy of October 2024:
1. Liquor retail was handed back to private shops for two years.
2. The shops (3,396) were allotted by e-auction.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Both are correct: retail went back to 3,396 private shops allotted by e-auction for two years.

s: What was Andhra Pradesh's stamps and registration revenue in 2025-26?
x: Stamps and registration rose from ₹3,476 crore (2016-17) to ₹8,023 crore, ₹9,200 crore (2024-25 RE) and ₹11,047 crore (2025-26).

s: Before the introduction of GST, which item accounted for approximately 73 per cent of Andhra Pradesh's total tax revenue in 2016-17 RE?
x: Before GST, Sales Tax/VAT accounted for approximately 73 per cent of Andhra Pradesh's total tax revenue in 2016-17 RE.

s: What was Andhra Pradesh's stamps and registration revenue in 2016-17?
x: Stamps and registration brought ₹3,476 crore in 2016-17, rising to ₹11,047 crore by 2025-26.

s: Which of the following is NOT part of a State's own non-tax revenue?
x: Market borrowings are a capital receipt; user charges, royalties and fines are non-tax revenue.

s: During 2014-15 to 2023-24, capital expenditure of all States formed about what share of their total spending?
x: Capital expenditure was about 13–20 percent of total spending of all States, revenue expenditure about 80–87 percent.

s: Towards which sectors is Andhra Pradesh's higher capital outlay mainly directed?
o: Irrigation and flood control, water supply and sanitation, and urban development
Rice subsidy, fee reimbursement and DBT schemes
Police, general administration and tax collection
x: Higher capital outlay is directed towards irrigation and flood control, water supply and sanitation, and urban development.

s: What did the Economic Survey 2025-26 urge for unconditional cash transfers?
x: The Economic Survey 2025-26 urged conditional transfers or sunset clauses for unconditional cash transfers.

s: In Andhra Pradesh, the actual capital outlay during 2024-25 was approximately what percentage below the Budget Estimate of ₹32,713 crore?
x: The actual capital outlay was ₹16,141 crore against the Budget Estimate of ₹32,713 crore, representing a shortfall of about 51 percent.

s: Which one of the following capital-outlay shares is NOT correctly matched with the corresponding year in Andhra Pradesh?
x: The 2024-25 RE capital-outlay share was approximately 9.7 percent, not 11.9 percent. The 11.9 percent figure relates to 2025-26 RE.

s: Why does welfare spending such as DBT widen Andhra Pradesh's revenue deficit?
o: It creates assets that must be maintained
It is a recurring revenue expenditure
It is financed by capital receipts
It is counted as debt repayment
x: Welfare/DBT is revenue expenditure that creates no asset, so it is a recurring liability that widens the revenue deficit.

s: What does capital expenditure by a State government mainly reflect its commitment to?
x: As per the PYQ key, capex signals commitment to building infrastructure; AP's capex stayed below 15% of total expenditure in 2016-21.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about developmental and non-developmental expenditure?
o: Construction of irrigation dams can be developmental capital expenditure
Developmental expenditure may be incurred as revenue expenditure
Salaries of teachers can be developmental revenue expenditure
The developmental classification is identical to the revenue-capital classification
x: The developmental/non-developmental division cuts across the revenue/capital division; it is not identical to it.

s: What do high interest payments, administrative costs and welfare commitments in AP's finances lead to?
o: Fiscal rigidity and crowding out of capital outlay
x: These committed items create fiscal rigidity and crowd out capital outlay.

s: Which one of the following is NOT generally classified as developmental expenditure?
x: Defence is classified as non-developmental expenditure. Rural development, social welfare and public health are developmental activities.

s: Which one of the following combinations consists entirely of non-developmental expenditure items?
o: Interest payments, police and law and order, tax-collection charges
Employment, rural development and public health
x: Interest payments, police and law and order, tax-collection charges and administrative expenditure are non-developmental items.

s: What pension does the AP Guaranteed Pension System Act, 2023 guarantee?
x: The AP GPS Act, 2023 guarantees 50% of the last basic pay.

s:
Consider the following statements about salary and pension reforms in Andhra Pradesh:
1. The AP Guaranteed Pension System Act was passed in 2023.
2. The 12th Pay Revision Commission was set up, due from 1 July 2023.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Both are correct: the GPS Act came in 2023 and the 12th PRC is due from 1 July 2023.

s: In the AP Budget 2026-27, pensions of ₹23,713 crore form about what share of revenue receipts?
x: Pensions are about 10% of receipts; interest (₹37,281 crore) is about 16%.

s: In 2023-24, committed expenditure and subsidies together formed what share of the revenue expenditure of all States?
x: For all States, committed expenditure plus subsidies was 51.76% of revenue expenditure in 2023-24.

s: In budget classification, how is welfare spending such as pensions and recurring subsidies treated?
x: Welfare schemes are revenue expenditure; they create no assets and impose recurring liabilities, so they can widen the revenue deficit.

s: Andhra Pradesh's capital outlay rose from Rs 7,244 crore in 2022-23 to what amount in 2023-24?
x: Capital outlay more than tripled to Rs 23,331 crore in 2023-24 and increased further thereafter.

s: In the Andhra Pradesh Budget for 2026-27, interest payments were estimated at approximately what percentage of revenue receipts?
x: Interest payments of Rs. 37,281 crore were estimated to constitute 16 percent of Andhra Pradesh's revenue receipts in 2026-27.

s: To whom does revenue from the auction of mineral blocks, including critical minerals, accrue?
x: Auction revenue from mineral blocks, including critical minerals, accrues to State governments.

s: Raising user charges for public services is generally used as a measure of:
x: Increasing user charges is a standard fiscal-consolidation tool because it can augment non-tax revenue and reduce the gap between receipts and expenditure.

s: With which area of Andhra Pradesh is mica mainly associated?
x: Mica occurs in the Nellore belt, limestone in the Kadapa-Kurnool basins and barytes at Mangampet.

s: In AP's 2025-26 RE, which was the second-largest source of own non-tax revenue after Mines and Minerals?
x: Mines and Minerals accounted for 37 per cent and Medical and Health for 34 per cent of non-tax revenue in 2025-26 RE.

s: Which of the following is a component of a State's own non-tax revenue?
x: Interest receipts, royalties and user charges are non-tax revenue, which is not raised by taxing the public.

s: How are profits and dividends of State PSUs in Andhra Pradesh treated?
o: Non-tax revenue retained by the State
x: Profits and dividends of State PSUs are non-tax revenue retained by the State.

s: Which one of the following is NOT listed among the major minerals of Andhra Pradesh?
x: Barytes, dolomite and uranium are listed among Andhra Pradesh's minerals. Platinum is not included in the specified list.

s: On which of the following is royalty on minerals levied ad valorem?
o: Market value of the lease area
x: Under the MMDR Act, 1957, royalty is levied ad valorem on the Average Sale Price.

s: Section 9D, introduced through an amendment to the Mines and Minerals (Development and Regulation) framework, relates to which of the following?
o: A scheme for providing free sand to rural households
A ban on auctioning mineral-bearing areas by the States
A Centre-controlled framework determining future State levies on minerals
A statutory trust for distributing mining royalties among districts
x: Section 9D makes future State levies on minerals dependent on a Centre-controlled framework. This provision has been criticised as unfair to mineral-rich States.

s:
Regarding the Supreme Court's position on mineral royalty, consider:
1. States cannot tax mineral-bearing land.
2. Royalty is not a tax.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
x: The Supreme Court reaffirmed that royalty is not a tax and that States may tax mineral-bearing land, so statement 1 is wrong.

s: The District Mineral Foundation is a non-profit trust constituted under which Section of the MMDR Amendment Act, 2015?
x: The DMF is a non-profit trust established under Section 9B of the MMDR Amendment Act, 2015.

s: What is Andhra Pradesh called because of its rich mineral wealth?
x: AP is called 'Ratna Garbha' (womb of gems), with minerals a key revenue source. The other names are not used for AP's mineral wealth.

s: In the 2024-25 RE, Mines and Minerals contributed about what share of AP's own non-tax revenue?
Where is barytes mainly mined in Andhra Pradesh?
x: Barytes is at Mangampet in YSR Kadapa; mica is in the Nellore belt and limestone in the Kadapa–Kurnool basins.

s: When was Andhra Pradesh's Free Sand Policy introduced?
x: The Free Sand Policy dates from 8 July 2024.

s: What do buyers pay under Andhra Pradesh's Free Sand Policy (2024)?
o: an auction price fixed by the district
only operation cost, seigniorage and taxes
x: Buyers pay only the operation cost, seigniorage and taxes.

s: With which area of Andhra Pradesh is limestone mainly associated?
x: Limestone in AP is mainly found in the Kadapa–Kurnool basins; barytes is at Mangampet and mica in the Nellore belt.

s: In which year's Budget session was Andhra Pradesh's Socio-Economic Survey, traditionally tabled before the Budget speech, skipped?
x: The Survey was skipped in the 2026 Budget session; its presentation is not a constitutional obligation.

s: What majority do decisions of the GST Council require?
x: GST Council decisions need a three-fourths majority; GST began on 1 July 2017 under the 101st Amendment Act, 2016.

s: Under which Article are the estimated receipts and expenditure of the Government of India for every financial year laid before both Houses of Parliament?
x: Article 112 requires the Annual Financial Statement (the Budget) to be laid before both Houses. Article 110 defines a Money Bill, 114 covers Appropriation Bills, and 116 votes on account.

s: Article 202 of the Constitution relates to the Annual Financial Statement of which of the following?
x: Article 202 provides for the Annual Financial Statement of a State, whereas Article 112 concerns the Union.

s: Revenue deficit grants to Andhra Pradesh after devolution were provided under which Article of the Constitution?
x: Revenue deficit grants are provided under Article 275. Article 270 concerns distribution of taxes, while Article 280 provides for the Finance Commission.

s: Taxes are shared between the Union and the States under Article 270. Under which Article is the Finance Commission constituted?
x: Article 270 deals with the distribution of taxes, while Article 280 provides for the Finance Commission.

s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Article 279A – Concurrent power to make GST laws
x: Article 269A concerns IGST; Article 246A gives concurrent GST legislative power and Article 279A establishes the GST Council.

s: Which of the following statements is incorrect?
o: The Annual Financial Statement is the main Budget document.
Gender Budgeting was introduced in the Union Budget 2006–07.
Capital receipts may create liability or reduce financial assets.
Revenue receipts do not create liability and do not reduce government assets.
x: Option B is incorrect: gender budgeting entered the Union Budget in 2005–06, not 2006–07. The Annual Financial Statement is the main Budget document.

s: In the Union model of budgeting, as which statement, and since when, is the Gender Budget presented?
x: The Gender Budget is Statement 13 (since 2005-06); the Child Budget is Statement 12 (since 2009-10).

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Budget documents of Andhra Pradesh?
o: The Annual Financial Statement is the main Budget document
The Socio-Economic Survey is traditionally tabled before the budget speech
Tabling the Socio-Economic Survey is a constitutional duty
The Socio-Economic Survey was dropped in the 2026 Budget session
x: The Socio-Economic Survey is not a constitutional duty, which is why it could be dropped in the 2026 session.

s: Under which Article does a State need the Centre's consent to borrow while it owes loans to the Centre?
x: Article 293(3) requires a State to get the Centre's consent to borrow while loans or guarantees from the Centre are outstanding.

s: What is the full form of CFMS, introduced in Andhra Pradesh in 2018 to run treasury and payments online?
x: CFMS is the Comprehensive Financial Management System, which centralised treasury and payments online.

s: Which Constitutional Amendment Act introduced the Goods and Services Tax (GST) in India?
x: GST was introduced by the Constitution (101st Amendment) Act, 2016.

s: From which date did GST come into force in India?
x: After the 101st Amendment Act, 2016, GST came into force on 1 July 2017.

s: In the Union Budget, as which statement, and since when, is the Child Budget presented?
x: The Child Budget is Statement 12 (since 2009-10); the Gender Budget is Statement 13 (since 2005-06).

s: When did GST compensation to States for revenue loss end?
x: GST compensation to States ended in June 2022, contributing to concerns about the loss of tax autonomy after GST.

s: In February 2021, Andhra Pradesh became eligible for additional borrowing after completing power-sector reforms prescribed by which authority?
o: Department of Expenditure, Ministry of Finance
x: The power-sector reforms were prescribed by the Department of Expenditure under the Ministry of Finance and were linked to eligibility for additional borrowing.

s: Which was NOT one of the four citizen-centric reforms linked to additional borrowing (2020-21)?
x: The four reforms were ONORC, ease of doing business, urban local body reforms and power sector reforms.

s: Which States were the first to complete three of the four reform-linked borrowing reforms?
x: AP and MP were the first States to complete three of four reforms.

s: In February 2021, AP's power-sector reform for extra borrowing involved DBT of farm power subsidy, piloted in which district?
x: AP got ₹1,515 crore extra borrowing for DBT of farm power subsidy, piloted in Srikakulam.

s: How much additional borrowing did Andhra Pradesh get in September 2020 for the One Nation One Ration Card reform?
x: AP got ₹2,525 crore of extra borrowing for completing the One Nation One Ration Card reform (September 2020).

s: How much additional borrowing did Andhra Pradesh get in February 2021 for power-sector reforms?
x: In February 2021 AP got ₹1,515 crore of extra borrowing for power-sector reforms, the 2nd State after Madhya Pradesh.

s: Which one of the following correctly shows the revenue deficit of Andhra Pradesh in 2026-27 BE?
x: The 2026-27 Budget Estimate provided for a revenue deficit of ₹22,003 crore, or approximately 1.1% of GSDP.

s: The Andhra Pradesh Budget 2026-27 has a total outlay of ₹3,32,205 crore. What is its net expenditure, excluding debt repayment?
x: Net expenditure excluding debt repayment is ₹3,10,058 crore (12% over 2025-26 RE); adding debt repayment of ₹22,147 crore gives the total outlay of ₹3,32,205 crore. ₹2,56,143 crore is revenue expenditure; ₹2,69,928 crore was net expenditure in 2024-25 BE.

s: What fiscal deficit does the Andhra Pradesh Budget 2026-27 (BE) project?
x: The 2026-27 BE fiscal deficit is ₹75,868 crore, about 3.8% of GSDP. ₹81,362 crore (5.11%) was the 2024-25 actual; ₹80,567 crore (4.57%) the 2025-26 RE; ₹22,003 crore (1.1%) is the 2026-27 revenue deficit.

s: In 2026-27, interest payments and principal repayment together accounted for how many paise of every rupee in Andhra Pradesh?
x: Interest and principal took 18 paise, level with welfare at 17 paise, and the State continued to run a primary deficit.

s: The capital outlay of Andhra Pradesh in 2026-27 Budget Estimates is approximately what share of net spending?
x: The capital outlay of ₹48,698 crore in 2026-27 BE constituted approximately 15.7 percent of net spending.

s: What is Andhra Pradesh's revenue expenditure in the 2026-27 Budget Estimates?
x: Revenue expenditure is ₹2,56,143 crore; ₹3,10,058 crore is net expenditure and ₹48,698 crore is capital outlay.

s: What was Andhra Pradesh's fiscal deficit in 2024-25 (actual)?
x: The 2024-25 actual fiscal deficit was ₹81,362 crore (5.11%); ₹80,567 crore is 2025-26 RE and ₹60,285 crore the 2024-25 revenue deficit.

s: By about what percentage did Andhra Pradesh's capital outlay rise in the 2026-27 Budget Estimates?
x: Capital outlay rose about 47% to ₹48,698 crore in 2026-27 BE.

s: What was Andhra Pradesh's allocation for education in 2026-27?
x: Education got Rs 35,673 crore, 11.7% of spending, against an all-States average of 14.5%.

s: Which scheme received the highest allocation among the following in the Andhra Pradesh Budget 2026-27?
x: NTR Bharosa Pension received Rs. 27,719 crore, exceeding Thalliki Vandanam at Rs. 8,456 crore, Annadata Sukhibhava at Rs. 6,600 crore and Amaravati capital at Rs. 6,000 crore.

s: Which one of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
x: Amaravati received ₹6,000 crore. ₹8,365 crore was allocated to VB-G RAM G.

s: What was the allocation for welfare of SCs, STs, OBCs and minorities in the Andhra Pradesh Budget 2026-27?
x: The combined welfare allocation for SCs, STs, OBCs and minorities was ₹52,855 crore.

x: The 16th FC noted that Andhra Pradesh has the highest per-capita spending on social security pensions (₹5,061). Kerala, Tamil Nadu and Telangana are not named for this.

s: Which sector recorded an increase of approximately 128% between 2024-25 Revised Estimates and 2025-26 Budget Estimates?
x: Agriculture and Allied increased from Rs. 6,192 crore in 2024-25 RE to Rs. 14,138 crore in 2025-26 BE, an increase of approximately 128%.

o: Reclassification of subsidies as capital receipts
Abolition of the Annadata Sukhibhava scheme

s: To what level is green cover in Andhra Pradesh to be raised from the present level of about 30%?
x: The green-cover targets are 37% by 2030 and 50% by 2047, compared with the present level of about 30%.

s: Within what period does the P4 (Public-Private-People Partnership) model in Andhra Pradesh aim at zero poverty?
x: P4 aims at zero poverty in five years, treating the family as the unit and linking DBT beneficiaries to jobs and self-employment.

s: Andhra Pradesh's education allocation in 2026-27 is 11.7% of spending. What is the all-States average?
x: AP spends 11.7% on education against an all-States average of 14.5%.

s: Which of the following pairs relating to the AP Budget 2026-27 is correctly matched?
x: Amaravati gets ₹6,000 crore; health is ₹19,630 crore, rural development ₹20,610 crore and urban development ₹12,541 crore.

s: The NTR Bharosa Pension allocation of ₹27,719 crore in 2026-27 is about what share of revenue expenditure?
x: NTR Bharosa Pension, the highest scheme allocation, is about 11% of revenue expenditure.

s: What was the allocation for Thalliki Vandanam in the AP Budget 2026-27?

s: What was the allocation for rural development in the AP Budget 2026-27?
x: Rural development got ₹20,610 crore (2026-27); ₹18,140 crore was the 2025-26 BE figure.

s: Which Andhra Pradesh scheme gives farmer investment support along with PM-Kisan, with ₹6,600 crore in the Budget 2026-27?
x: Annadata Sukhibhava, together with PM-Kisan, got ₹6,600 crore in 2026-27.

s: In the 2025-26 RE, Andhra Pradesh's capital outlay was about what share of total spending?
x: Capital outlay was ₹33,135 crore, about 11.9% in 2025-26 RE; 9.7% is 2024-25 RE and 15.7% the 2026-27 BE.

s: Which feature of Centrally Sponsored Schemes limits Andhra Pradesh's fiscal flexibility?
x: CSS make up about 40% of central transfers and carry rigid co-financing conditions, limiting the State's flexibility.

s: What did the Sixteenth Finance Commission urge that Centrally Sponsored Schemes should be?
x: The Sixteenth Finance Commission urges outcome-linked Centrally Sponsored Schemes.

s: Which one of the following is NOT correctly matched?
o: Centrally Sponsored Schemes — State or Concurrent subjects
Central Sector Schemes — 100 per cent funded by the Centre
Centrally Sponsored Schemes — implemented and wholly funded by a Central Ministry
Central Sector Schemes — Union List subjects
x: Centrally Sponsored Schemes concern State or Concurrent subjects and are jointly funded by the Centre and States. Central Sector Schemes are 100 per cent Centre-funded and run by Central Ministries.

s: Which of the following is correctly matched?
x: PM-KISAN and Ayushman Bharat are listed as Central Sector Schemes, whereas NHM and ICDS are Centrally Sponsored Schemes.

s: Which one of the following correctly states a criticism concerning Centrally Sponsored Schemes?
o: They increase the divisible pool by excluding State contributions.
They eliminate the need for any State contribution.
They are financed exclusively through cesses outside the divisible pool.
Their matching shares may squeeze the fiscal space of States.
x: The requirement of matching shares under Centrally Sponsored Schemes can place pressure on State finances and squeeze their fiscal space.

s: Special Category and Himalayan States ordinarily follow which Centre-State sharing pattern for Centrally Sponsored Schemes?
x: CSS ordinarily follow 90:10 for Special Category and Himalayan States and 60:40 for general States.

s: With which of the following is SNA-SPARSH associated?
o: Sharing Polavaram costs between two States
x: SNA-SPARSH enables just-in-time release of CSS funds through State IFMIS, RBI e-Kuber and PFMS.

s: Which Act replaced MGNREGA and raised the State share of the funding pattern to 60:40 for most States?
x: Under MGNREGA the Centre bore 100% of unskilled wages; its replacement, the VB-G RAM G Act, uses a 60:40 Centre-State pattern for most States, raising State contributions. NFSA concerns food grains, PM-KISAN is a Central Sector scheme and NRLM is a livelihoods mission, none of which replaced MGNREGA.

s: Which of the following is a Central Sector scheme, fully funded by the Centre?
x: PM-KISAN is a Central Sector scheme (100% Centre); NHM, ICDS and PMKSY are Centrally Sponsored.

s: Under SNA-SPARSH, just-in-time release of CSS funds flows through State IFMIS, PFMS and which other system?
x: SNA-SPARSH links State IFMIS, RBI e-Kuber and PFMS for just-in-time release.

s: Which State ranked first among States in 28 centrally sponsored and central sector schemes (up to November 2018)?
x: Andhra Pradesh ranked first in 28 CSS and central sector schemes up to November 2018.

s: How many Centrally Sponsored Schemes are covered by SNA-SPARSH for just-in-time release of funds?
x: SNA-SPARSH covers 66 CSS in 28 States and 3 UTs, cutting idle float from ₹1.67 to ₹0.4 lakh crore.

s: What was Andhra Pradesh's tax devolution in the 2026-27 Budget Estimates?
x: 2026-27 BE provides ₹64,362 crore; ₹50,475 crore and ₹52,080 crore were the 2024-25 BE and RE.

s: At what level did the 16th Finance Commission fix the States' share in the divisible pool of Union taxes?
x: The 16th FC, like the 15th, fixed the States' share at 41%; the 14th FC had fixed it at 42%.

s: What is Andhra Pradesh's share in the divisible pool under the 16th Finance Commission?
x: AP's share is 4.217% under the 16th FC, against about 4.05% under the 15th FC.

s: Which pair relating to the 16th Finance Commission award to Andhra Pradesh (2026–31) is correctly matched?
x: The 16th FC awarded ₹6,125 crore for disaster management; rural and urban local body grants are ₹16,627 crore and ₹12,158 crore respectively.

s:
Consider the following statements about the 16th Finance Commission:
1. It was chaired by Arvind Panagariya.
2. It retained the States' share in the divisible pool at 41%.
3. Eighteen States had asked for a 50% share for the States.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: All three are correct: the Panagariya-led 16th FC kept the States' share at 41% even though 18 States had sought 50%.

s: Andhra Pradesh received post-devolution revenue deficit grants under which Finance Commission(s)?
x: AP, a chronic revenue-deficit State after 2014, received these grants under the 14th and 15th Finance Commissions.

s: Which significant change is associated with the 16th Finance Commission’s recommendations for Andhra Pradesh?
o: It ended revenue-deficit grants to Andhra Pradesh.
It increased revenue-deficit grants to Andhra Pradesh.
It transferred disaster grants entirely to urban local bodies.
It abolished local-body grants to Andhra Pradesh.
x: The 16th Finance Commission ended revenue-deficit grants for Andhra Pradesh while providing grants for local bodies and disaster management.

s:
Consider the following statements about the SDRF/SDMF corpus of ₹2,04,401 crore under the 16th Finance Commission:
1. It is shared 75:25 (Centre:State) for general States.
2. It is shared 60:40 (Centre:State) for North-Eastern/Himalayan States.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: The corpus is shared 75:25 for general States and 90:10, not 60:40, for NE/Himalayan States.

s: Which criterion carries the highest weight in the 16th Finance Commission's horizontal devolution formula?
x: Income distance has 42.5% weight; population (2011) 17.5%, area and contribution to GDP 10% each.

s: Which criterion was newly added to the devolution formula by the 16th Finance Commission?
x: Contribution to GDP (10%) is new under FC-16, which dropped tax effort.

s: What was Andhra Pradesh's share in the divisible pool under the 15th Finance Commission?
x: AP's share was 4.305% (14th), 4.05% (15th) and 4.217% (16th FC).

s: What was Andhra Pradesh's tax devolution in the 2024-25 Revised Estimates?
x: Devolution was ₹50,475 crore in 2024-25 BE, ₹52,080 crore in RE and ₹64,362 crore in 2026-27 BE.

s: Under the 16th FC award to Andhra Pradesh (2026-31), what is the grant for rural local bodies?
x: Rural local bodies get ₹16,627 crore; urban local bodies ₹12,158 crore and disaster management ₹6,125 crore.

s: How much SDRF did Andhra Pradesh get under the 14th Finance Commission (2015-20)?
x: The 14th FC gave AP about ₹2,492 crore for SDRF; ₹6,125 crore is the 16th FC disaster award.

s: What was Andhra Pradesh's share in the divisible pool under the 14th Finance Commission?
x: AP's share was 4.305% under the 14th FC, 4.05% under the 15th and 4.217% under the 16th.

s: Which disasters were newly added to the SDRF/SDMF list under the 16th Finance Commission?
x: Under the 16th FC, heatwaves and lightning were added to the disaster list for SDRF/SDMF.

s: With which of the following was the cut from 42 per cent (Fourteenth FC) to 41 per cent (Fifteenth FC) in the States' share associated?
o: The change relating to Jammu and Kashmir
The discontinuation of Central Sector Schemes
x: The Fifteenth Finance Commission’s 41 per cent share reflected the change relating to Jammu and Kashmir.

s: Revenue-deficit grants to States are given under which Article of the Constitution?
x: Article 275 provides statutory grants, including revenue-deficit grants; Article 282 covers discretionary grants and 270 tax sharing.

s: Which Article of the Constitution is associated with discretionary grants to States?
x: Article 282 concerns discretionary grants; Article 275 provides statutory grants and Article 280(3)(bb),(c) relates to local bodies.

s: Which of the following pairs (Finance Commission – States' share in the divisible pool) is correctly matched?
x: The 14th FC raised the share from 32% to 42%; the 15th fixed it at 41% and the 16th retained 41%.

s: Special Category Status for States began in which year, on whose advice?
x: SCS began in 1969 on the advice of the Fifth Finance Commission. The 14th FC (2015) instead stopped distinguishing special and general category States; the First and Sixth FCs are not linked with its origin.

s: Which Finance Commission did not distinguish Special and General Category States in its devolution formula?
x: The Fourteenth Finance Commission did not distinguish Special and General Category States in its devolution formula.

s: The divisible pool of Union taxes is about what share of gross tax revenue?
x: The divisible pool is about 81% of gross tax revenue because cesses are excluded.

s: Which provisions of Article 280 relate to Finance Commission measures for local bodies?
x: Article 280(3)(bb) and (c) ask the FC to suggest measures for panchayats and municipalities.

s: During the Plan era, State Plans were financed through the State's own resources and which other source?
x: State Plans were financed by own resources plus Normal Central Assistance allocated under the Gadgil or Gadgil-Mukherjee formula.

s: Under the Gadgil-Mukherjee formula, what was the loan-grant composition of Normal Central Assistance for general category States?
x: For general category States, Normal Central Assistance consisted of loans and grants in a 70:30 ratio. For Special Category States, the ratio was 10:90.

s: Which one of the following changes was associated with the Union Budget from 2017-18?
o: Introduction of the first Outcome Budget
Introduction of the Railway Budget as a separate document
Dropping of the Plan and Non-Plan distinction
Restoration of the Plan and Non-Plan distinction
x: The Plan and Non-Plan distinction was dropped from 2017-18. This was distinct from the earlier introduction of the Outcome Budget in 2005.

s: Under the Gadgil formula, what was the loan-grant ratio of Normal Central Assistance for special category States?
x: NCA was 70:30 (loans:grants) for general States and 10:90 for special category States.

s: From which Union Budget was the presentation date moved to 1 February?
x: The 2017-18 Budget was advanced to 1 February, merged the Railway Budget and dropped Plan/non-Plan.

s: In which year was the Outcome Budget first introduced in India?
x: The Outcome Budget came in 2005, well before the Plan/non-Plan distinction was dropped in 2017-18.

s: What is the allocation for the Polavaram project in the AP Budget 2026-27?
x: Polavaram gets ₹6,105 crore within the ₹16,734 crore irrigation allocation; ₹6,000 crore is for Amaravati.

s: What was the older cited cost estimate of Polavaram, which the Centre is to fund as a national project?
x: An older cited estimate put Polavaram's cost at Rs 55,548 crore, funded by the Centre, though releases have been delayed.

s: The post-bifurcation revenue-deficit grant to Andhra Pradesh has been tapering off. Which amount was included in the SAM package as an RD grant?
x: The Special Assistance Measure package included an RD grant of Rs. 3,979 crore within the overall package of Rs. 24,350 crore.

s: How much was the Special Assistance Measure given to Andhra Pradesh in lieu of Special Category Status?
x: SCS was not granted; instead a Special Assistance Measure of Rs 24,350 crore was provided.

s: Under the package provided to Andhra Pradesh, what share of the cost of externally aided projects is borne by the Centre?
x: The Centre bears 90 per cent of the cost of externally aided projects under the package.

s: Polavaram was declared a national project under which Section of the APRA, 2014?
x: Polavaram is a national project under Section 90 of the APRA, 2014; Section 54 deals with debt apportionment.

s: What was the revised cost of Polavaram Phase I (August 2024)?
x: Phase I was revised to ₹30,436.95 crore in August 2024; ₹55,548 crore is the older estimate.

s: What was the externally aided project inflow to Andhra Pradesh in the 2025-26 RE?
x: EAP inflow was ₹16,252 crore (2024-25 RE) and ₹21,585 crore (2025-26 RE).

s: How much special assistance did the Centre give for Amaravati in January 2026?
x: The Centre gave ₹15,000 crore special assistance for Amaravati in January 2026.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Andhra Pradesh's dependence on central transfers?
o: Andhra Pradesh depended less on grants than the average State
The share was about 47% in the 2024-25 RE when EAP loans were included
About 40% of its revenues came from the Centre in the 2024-25 BE
CSS constitute about 40% of all central transfers to the State
x: Andhra Pradesh relies more on grants than the average State, not less.

s: The Andhra Pradesh Socio-Economic Survey identifies which of the following as a fiscal stress faced by the State?
o: Excessive anticipated flow of funds from the Government of India
Lesser than anticipated flow of funds from the Government of India
Excessive tax devolution compared with the Budget Estimate
Complete absence of Finance Commission transfers
x: The APSES 2024-25 lists lesser than anticipated flow of funds from the Government of India among Andhra Pradesh's fiscal stresses.

s: In the 2024-25 RE, total central resources to AP rose despite a fall in grants mainly because of which of the following?
x: Grants fell short of the Budget Estimate, but total resources rose because EAP loans were included in the Revised Estimate.

s: As per SES 2025-26 (2025-26 RE), what were the total central transfers to Andhra Pradesh and their largest component?
o: Rs 1,04,493 crore; other grants-in-aid including CSS
x: 2025-26 RE total central transfers were Rs 1,04,493 crore, with the Finance Commission line (Rs 62,188 crore) the largest. Rs 89,157 crore is the 2024-25 RE total and Rs 81,563 crore the 2022-23 total; other GIA incl. CSS was only Rs 21,711 crore.

s: In the 2024-25 RE, central transfers formed about what share of Andhra Pradesh's revenue receipts?
x: Central transfers were about 45% of AP's revenue receipts in 2024-25 RE.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the demographic indicators of Andhra Pradesh?
o: The literacy rate of Andhra Pradesh was higher than the national literacy rate
The sex ratio of Andhra Pradesh was 997
Krishna district recorded the highest population density, at 518 persons per sq km
The sex ratio of India was 943
x: AP literacy (67.35%) was below India's 72.98%, so this statement is false; the density of Krishna (518) and the sex ratios (AP 997, India 943) are correct.

s: As per Census 2011, what was the sex ratio of Andhra Pradesh?
x: AP's sex ratio was 997; 944 was its child sex ratio.

x: Andhra Pradesh accounted for 4.09% of India’s population and was ranked 10th on this indicator.

s: As per Census 2011-based indicators, what is the population density of Andhra Pradesh?
x: Andhra Pradesh (area 1,62,970 sq km) has a density of 304 persons per sq km; 382 is the India-level density.

s: As per Census 2011, what is the literacy rate of Andhra Pradesh?
x: AP's literacy is 67.35%, below India's 72.98%; 29.47% is AP's urbanisation.

s: What is Andhra Pradesh's rank in India by area (1,62,970 sq km)?
x:
Most books, keys and the AP SES: 8th. Strictly: 7th among the States since J&K became a Union Territory in Oct 2019 (general knowledge, not checked).

s: With the creation of which districts did Andhra Pradesh's districts rise from 26 to 28 on 31 December 2025?
x: Polavaram and Markapuram districts took the count from 26 to 28 from 31 December 2025.

s: Which one of the following pairs is correctly matched in respect of urbanisation and the number of districts in Andhra Pradesh?
x: Andhra Pradesh's urbanisation level is 29.47% and it has 28 districts since 31 December 2025 (26 from 2022). 47.45% is Visakhapatnam's urbanisation; 67.35% is not the urbanisation figure.

s: What is the length of Andhra Pradesh's coastline, the second longest in India?
x:

s: As per Census 2011, what was the child sex ratio of Andhra Pradesh?
x: AP's child sex ratio was 944 against India's 918; the overall sex ratio was 997.

s: Who prepares the Socio-Economic Survey of Andhra Pradesh?
o: Planning Department, Government of Andhra Pradesh
x: The Socio-Economic Survey is prepared by the Planning Department of the Government of Andhra Pradesh.

s: By convention, when is the Andhra Pradesh Socio-Economic Survey tabled?
o: At the end of the financial year
Only along with the Annual Financial Statement after voting
After the State Budget is passed
x: By convention, the Survey is tabled before the State Budget, following the practice of the Union Economic Survey.

s: Which one of the following is NOT a chapter of SES 2025-26?
x: “Progress Monitoring - KPIs and SDGs” was the last chapter of SES 2024-25, not a listed chapter of SES 2025-26.

s: Which is the last chapter of the AP Socio-Economic Survey 2025-26?
x: SES 2025-26 has 11 chapters and its last is Data-Driven Governance; Progress Monitoring – KPIs and SDGs was the last chapter of SES 2024-25.

s:

x: SES 2025-26 has 11 chapters and uses First Advance Estimates; its last chapter is Data-Driven Governance, while Progress Monitoring – KPIs and SDGs closed SES 2024-25.

s: What was the final revised estimate of Andhra Pradesh's 2024-25 GSDP?
o: Rs 15.91 lakh crore at current prices and Rs 8.67 lakh crore at constant prices
Rs 16.06 lakh crore at current prices and Rs 8.73 lakh crore at constant prices
Rs 15.91 lakh crore at current prices and Rs 8.73 lakh crore at constant prices
Rs 17.62 lakh crore at current prices and Rs 9.52 lakh crore at constant prices
x: The 2024-25 FRE is Rs 15.91 lakh crore at current prices and Rs 8.67 lakh crore at constant prices.

s: What was Andhra Pradesh's real GSDP growth in 2025-26?

s: What was the nominal GSDP of Andhra Pradesh in 2025-26 estimated at?
x: The 2025-26 nominal GSDP was estimated at ₹17.62 lakh crore, showing growth of 10.75%. The ₹19.75 lakh crore figure is the projected current-price GSDP for 2026-27.

s: What was Andhra Pradesh's per capita income in 2025-26 estimated at?

s: As per the 2025-26 FAE, what was the growth rate of Andhra Pradesh's agriculture and allied sector?
x: AP's agriculture and allied sector grew 10.14% (India 3.1%); 9.15% is AP's industry and 10.67% its services growth.

s: As per the 2024-25 Survey figures, which broad sector had the largest current-price GVA and what was its value?

s: As per the 2025-26 FAE, by how much did Andhra Pradesh's per capita income grow?
x: PCI rose 10.43% to ₹2,94,507; 10.75% and 9.88% are GSDP growth at current and constant prices.

s: Against Andhra Pradesh's per capita income of ₹2,94,507 in 2025-26, what was India's per capita income?
x: India's per capita income was ₹2,19,575, well below Andhra Pradesh's ₹2,94,507.

s: What was Andhra Pradesh's GSDP growth at current prices in 2025-26 (FAE)?
x: GSDP at current prices grew 10.75% to ₹17.62 lakh crore; 9.88% is the constant-price (real) growth.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Andhra Pradesh's sectoral growth in 2025-26 (FAE)?
o: Agriculture and allied was the fastest-growing sector
x: Services was the fastest-growing sector at 10.67%, ahead of agriculture and allied (10.14%) and industry (9.15%).

s: What is Andhra Pradesh's rank among the States of India by GSDP?
x: The Survey places Andhra Pradesh 8th by GSDP.

s: The revenue-deficit estimate of about ₹48,000 crore for Andhra Pradesh in 2025-26 was associated with which development?
o: The removal of all central tax devolution to Andhra Pradesh
The introduction of revenue-deficit grants by the Sixteenth Finance Commission
The end of revenue-deficit grants by the Sixteenth Finance Commission
The replacement of the Finance Commission by NITI Aayog

s: Andhra Pradesh's revenue deficit in 2025-26 RE was ₹41,118 crore, which is what share of GSDP?

s: What is the Maternal Mortality Ratio (2018-20) of Andhra Pradesh, against India's 97?

s: At what level did the second Advance Estimates place total foodgrain production in Andhra Pradesh in 2025-26?

x: For ages 15–59, unemployment was 4.4% and LFPR was 67.3%; these differ from the all-age figures.

s: Which region of Andhra Pradesh is being developed as a Horticulture Hub?
x: The Survey states that Rayalaseema is being developed as a Horticulture Hub. The other regions are not named for this.

s: What is Andhra Pradesh's share in India's fish production?
x: AP produces about 29% of India's fish and ranks first.

s: As per PLFS 2023-24, what was the Labour Force Participation Rate (all ages) of Andhra Pradesh?
x: LFPR was 47.5% and WPR 45.6%; 67.3% is the LFPR for ages 15-59.

s: According to the Survey data for 2025-26, Andhra Pradesh held the first rank in which of the following?
x: Andhra Pradesh ranked first in fruit production, accounting for 15.6% of India's production. It ranked seventh in milk, second in raw silk and sixth in exports.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Andhra Pradesh's ranks reported in the Socio-Economic Survey?
o: Andhra Pradesh ranked first in egg production
Andhra Pradesh ranked first in milk production
Andhra Pradesh produced 139.46 lakh MT of milk
x: Andhra Pradesh ranked seventh, not first, in milk production (139.46 lakh MT); it ranked first in eggs with 2,739 crore.

Indian Council of Agricultural Research–National Research Centre for Banana

s: Which beach in Andhra Pradesh holds the Blue Flag certification as reported in the Survey?
x: Rushikonda beach (Visakhapatnam) holds the Blue Flag certification. The other beaches are not the ones named as holding it.

s: What rank did Andhra Pradesh get in NITI Aayog's Fiscal Health Index 2023-24 (released March 2026)?
x: AP ranked 17th in the Fiscal Health Index 2023-24. 8th is AP's GSDP rank and 10th its population-share rank; 1st is wrong.

s: Which of the following pairs of Andhra Pradesh's national ranks is correctly matched?
x: AP is 2nd in raw silk; it is 4th in meat, 7th in milk and 6th in exports.

s: For what purpose are CORS (Continuously Operating Reference Stations) used in Andhra Pradesh?
x: The Survey reports CORS being used for the land resurvey.

s: In the ODOP-2024 awards, Andhra Pradesh won the State Award and how many of the 12 District Awards?
x: Andhra Pradesh won the ODOP-2024 State Award and 10 of the 12 District Awards.

s: Which welfare scheme provided three free LPG cylinders a year?
x: Deepam-2 provided three free LPG cylinders a year.

s: According to the latest Socio-Economic Survey of Andhra Pradesh, how many Rythu Seva Kendras were functional after rationalisation?
x: 8,489 RSKs were functional after rationalisation. The Survey's 10,778 and 10,606 figures refer to RSKs providing soil sampling and animal husbandry services; 3,863 is the count of ward secretariats.

s: Stree Shakti, launched for free bus travel for women, was associated with which figures?

From 15 August 2025 and 1.84 crore free journeys
From 15 August 2024 and 33.32 lakh free journeys
x: Stree Shakti provided free bus travel for women from 15 August 2025 and recorded 33.32 crore free journeys.

s:

x: There are 15,004 village and ward secretariats, of which 3,863 are ward secretariats; 8,489 is the number of Rythu Seva Kendras.

s: How many ward secretariats are there in Andhra Pradesh as per the Survey?
x: There are 3,863 ward secretariats within 15,004 village and ward secretariats; 8,489 is the number of Rythu Seva Kendras.

s: About how many rural Self-Help Groups are there under SERP in Andhra Pradesh?
x: SERP has 8.34 lakh rural SHGs covering 84.47 lakh women.

s: How much was released under NTR Bharosa from December 2024 to November 2025?
x: ₹32,754.90 crore was released under NTR Bharosa; ₹1,554.06 crore was spent on Deepam-2.

s: How many beneficiaries were covered under Deepam-2, which gives three free LPG cylinders a year?
x: Deepam-2 covers 1.84 crore beneficiaries at a cost of ₹1,554.06 crore; 33.32 crore is Stree Shakti's free journeys.

s: What were Rythu Seva Kendras in Andhra Pradesh earlier known as?
x: Rythu Seva Kendras are the former Rythu Bharosa Kendras; 8,489 are functional after rationalisation.
